label: class_e_07_battle_01
text: Osu! This is our last class, but don’t let those\nenergy levels drop before we wrap things up![VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: class_e_07_battle_02
text: You’ve shown that you have more than enough\nknowledge to be superstrong battlers![VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: class_e_07_battle_03
text: I don’t know that I have much left to teach you...[VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: class_e_07_battle_04
text: but we can always aim for ever-greater heights![VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: class_e_07_battle_05
text: So today, I’m going to teach you about the rules\nof Link Battles![VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: class_e_07_battle_06
text: When two Trainers participate in Link Battles\ntogether, they can engage in either Single Battles\r\nor Double Battles with each other![VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: class_e_07_battle_07
text: And if you’re playing in a group of four, you can\nall battle each other in Multi Battles![VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: class_e_07_battle_08
text: Now, when you’re out having battles during your\nindependent study, you can use whatever number\r\nof Pokémon you like—and they can be any level![VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: class_e_07_battle_09
text: But, in Link Battles, there are special rules to\nkeep in mind.[VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: class_e_07_battle_10
text: Some of these special rules involve adjusting\nPokémon’s levels![VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: class_e_07_battle_11
text:
Now, the [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]No Restrictions [VAR 0xFF00(0000)]rule set lets all Pokémon
stay at their current level.\c
It lets Trainers use multiple Pokémon of the same
species and multiples of the same held item, too![VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: class_e_07_battle_12
text: But if you choose to use [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]Normal Rules[VAR 0xFF00(0000)], all\nPokémon will be set to Lv. 50 for your battles—\r\nregardless of what level they actually are.[VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: class_e_07_battle_13
text: This even includes lower-level Pokémon. They’ll\nget a power boost to participate![VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: class_e_07_battle_14
text: Normal Rules let you use multiples of the same\nPokémon species and of the same held items too.[VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: class_e_07_battle_15
text: The great part about this rule set is that it lets\nany of your Pokémon participate—all they have\r\nto do is learn some good moves![VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: class_e_07_battle_16
text: Lastly, the rule set called [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]Flat Rules[VAR 0xFF00(0000)] mostly affects\nPokémon over Lv. 50. Such Pokémon will be set\r\nto Lv. 50 for the duration of the battle![VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: class_e_07_battle_17
text: The Flat Rules rule set is the one often used for\nofficial tournaments.[VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: class_e_07_battle_18
text: This rule set does NOT allow Trainers to use\nmultiple Pokémon of the same species or\r\nmultiples of the same held item![VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: class_e_07_battle_19
text: All right. Here’s a question for you![VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: class_e_07_battle_20
text: Which rule set should you pick if you want to use\na lower-level Pokémon and keep its level low?[VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: class_e_07_select_01
text: Normal Rules

label: class_e_07_select_02
text: Flat Rules

label: class_e_07_battle_answer_01
text: Oooh, gotcha there! Normal Rules adjusts all\nPokémon to Lv. 50—even lower-level ones![VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: class_e_07_battle_answer_02
text: That’s the one, new kid! Looks like you were\nlistening to the lesson![VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: class_e_07_battle_21
text: If you’ve got some clever strategy that you need\nto use a Lv. 5 Pokémon for, your best bet is to\r\nchoose the Flat Rules rule set![VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: class_e_07_battle_22
text: Of course, you can also choose No Restrictions if\nyou want to battle with any Pokémon you want—\r\nat any level and with any held item![VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: class_e_07_battle_23
text: That’s a pretty good rule set for when you want\nto battle freely with friends.[VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: class_e_07_battle_24
text: In conclusion![VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: class_e_07_battle_25
text: Normal Rules adjusts all Pokémon to Lv. 50!\c\nFlat Rules lets you use lower-level Pokémon at\ntheir actual levels![VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: class_e_07_battle_26
text: I hope you’ll use these tips to have some exciting\nbattles with your friends![VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: class_e_07_battle_27
text: Aw, man! I was just about to suggest we do some\nhands-on practice to really drive the point home,\r\nbut I guess we truly are out of time...[VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: class_e_07_battle_28
text: Next class will be our final exam! Aim for a\nperfect score! Osu! Osu![VAR 0x0114(0024)]
